items.title: Barry Kernfeld interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 16, 2020
items.q: I actually liked them a lot more without Janis.

ctx.x: No, no, no, not necessarily. They were, I actually liked them a lot more without Janis. They were great improvisers and had really interesting two-line things going. So you know that was the kind of thing that I was able to hear.
That’s awesome. Did you distinguish at that time between white musicians in rock and black musicians in rock? Was there anything that made them different from one another?
